description:
We are The Astro Voyagers from Daffodil International University, Bangladesh: Md Abdul Quym Shanto (Lead), Sajid Ahasan (AI/ML), Tawhid Ahmed Saad (Backend), MD Sabbir Hossien (Frontend & UI), Arpita Kundu (Data & Research) and Mahabub Hasan (Media). We built FarmShield AI: seven NASA datasets help farmers compare crop rotations and see flood, water and crop-health risks for their field, in Bangla or English.

Try it: https://farm-shield-ai-pi.vercel.app
